task: T12 bounded and safe recovery after loss of route progress

implementation.progress_watchdog: Path progress is projected along the active route and made monotonic. No-progress time accrues only while positive translation is commanded; in-place turns and explicit holds pause the watchdog.
implementation.recovery_maneuver: One reverse-then-turn maneuver per goal: retreat 0.12 m, rotate 0.60 rad, speeds 0.06 m/s and 0.40 rad/s, total timeout 4.0 s.
implementation.space_checks: Each reverse command checks the fresh-scan stopping corridor and inflated static/known occupancy along the swept retreat. Rotation checks fresh scan clearance and the inflated map footprint; either turn direction is selected only if clear.
implementation.energy_and_attempt_limits: Recovery starts only when battery covers conservative return energy with localization margin, return_reserve, and 1.0 additional recovery energy. At most one recovery attempt is allowed per goal; existing max_replans bounds subsequent route retries, after which exploration is abandoned or return fails explicitly.
implementation.failure_behavior: Blocked or timed-out recovery stops immediately and triggers one validated route recomputation; unreachable return fails as stuck_returning/no_route_home rather than repeating motion indefinitely.

limitations: The bounded recovery behavior is covered by unit/application tests and the live probe confirmed that the watchdog enters recovery. A complete physical reverse-then-turn sequence has not yet been verified; the probe run was interrupted by a concurrent sample-sensor anomaly and route replan.

The probe supplies isolated odometry on /t12/odom while Gazebo executes the same velocity commands; therefore it is a controlled induced-stall test, not a natural mechanical-stuck reproduction. Sample signal is held constant in the relay to isolate recovery from unrelated sensor behavior.
The configured recovery energy budget is a conservative project setting for the local judge and should be calibrated against measured reverse/turn battery loss before final evaluation.
